question: According to Census of India 2011, which state recorded the second lowest literacy rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** recorded the second lowest literacy rate in India according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The literacy rate in Arunachal Pradesh was significantly lower compared to other states, with only **66.95%** of its population being literate.
 
• The state with the lowest literacy rate was **Bihar**, with a literacy rate of **61.80%**.
 
• Efforts have been made to improve literacy rates in these states through various educational programs and initiatives.
 
• The literacy rate is a critical indicator of socio-economic progress and development in any region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years and provides comprehensive data on various demographic parameters including literacy rates.
 
• The literacy rate is calculated as the percentage of people aged seven years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• Improving literacy rates is a priority for both the central and state governments in India.
 
• Various schemes such as the **National Literacy Mission** and **Saakshar Bharat** have been implemented to enhance literacy levels across the country.
 
• Education plays a pivotal role in the socio-economic development and empowerment of individuals and communities.
